data.one_liner: An in-memory fuzzy text searching library for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple in-memory fuzzy text searching capabilities for Dart applications. It allows querying a list of searchable items using terms and handles fuzzy matching logic.
use_when: You need in-memory fuzzy text search for small to medium datasets
You want a pure Dart solution working across all platforms
avoid_when: You need a full-text database search for massive datasets
You require complex relational querying capabilities
strengths: Simple API with clear usage examples
Works across all Flutter platforms including web and desktop
weaknesses: Lacks advanced NLP or database indexing features
